headline: Ahn'Qiraj in 57:00 to open a three-raid night

mvp.headline: the most damage on the Bug Trio, Huhuran and the Twins, no deaths
why: First on the Bug Trio, Princess Huhuran and the Twin Emperors (165k), second on Skeram, Sartura and C'Thun
Average parse 90, with 98 on the Twins
Also the most damage on Firemaw and Gehennas later the same night

also.text: tanked all nine bosses, parse 97 on Fankriss and 96 on the Twins
the most healing on five bosses, 99k on C'Thun
Rebirth on Eduard after Dark Glare at 0:55 on C'Thun

overview: Nine kills on nine pulls in 57:00, 21 minutes under a usual night, to start an evening that went on to Blackwing Lair and Molten Core. The guild's fastest is still 1 Nov's 51:27.

Skeram went without world buffs on anyone (stored in Chronoboons, by the look of it), then 39 of 40 had Rallying Cry from the Bug Trio to the Twins. Ouro and C'Thun were fought with buffs on 2 and 1 raiders. Only Roguina died on the Twins, so they weren't lost to deaths. Ouro was the one boss slower than usual.
Nine deaths: four on C'Thun, one each on Sartura, the Twins and Ouro, two on trash.

wentWell.text: 9 of Skeram's 11 Arcane Explosions kicked (Labwar and Wellan 2 each).
Sartura's Whirlwind hit 2.0 per raider, against a usual 4.8.
Twin Emperors in 2:37 against a usual 4:03, Blizzard hits at half the usual rate.
C'Thun in 4:27 (median 5:11), Eye Beam hits at half the usual rate.

notes.text: 1:09 (median 1:13) with no Rallying Cry on anyone, no deaths. 9 of 11 Arcane Explosions interrupted.
1:10 (median 1:21), no deaths. Yauj started 3 Great Heals and Fluffycatto kicked 2; the third healed her for 55k. Toxic Volley hits at half the usual rate.
0:58 (median 1:10). Whirlwind at less than half the usual rate; it killed Roguina at 0:35. Imnevermor top at 68k.
1:38 (best 1:33), no deaths. Poison Bolt Volley hits at half the usual rate. Youlloveme 79k healing.
0:37 (best 0:33), no deaths. 17 Nature Protection Potions, and the one Frenzy tranquilized by Emanuelxxion.
2:37 (best 2:09, median 4:03). One death, Roguina to Arcane Burst at 0:34.
1:52 against a usual 1:43, with 2 raiders buffed. Phemmy died to Sand Blast at 0:26, and Sweep hit 2.25 per raider against a usual 1.7.
4:27, four deaths. Eduard to Dark Glare at 0:55 (back up through Skoomael's Rebirth), Emanuelxxion to an Eye Beam at 3:34, Marulock in the stomach late on.
